name: 66209 · Leawood, KS
findings: ZIP 66209 (Leawood) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66209 (Leawood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
